cards.title: Monitor Point approved: 1,324 waterfront apartments
cards.kicker: Council signs off on Quay St towers

cards.title: Murawski Pharmacy carries on after its owner's death
cards.kicker: 48 years of Polish goods on Nassau
cards.summary: Timothy Murawski died on July 10; his family is keeping the counter, the Western Union and the Polish-speaking staff going against tariffs, chains and shrinking reimbursement rates.

sourceLinks.title: How Murawski Pharmacy Is Keeping Late Owner's Legacy Alive

cards.sourceQuote:
Murawski Pharmacy has been a cornerstone of the Greenpoint community for nearly five decades. Owner Timothy Murawski sadly passed away on July 10 , and his family is working to honor his legacy. He and his brother Kenneth opened the store 48 years ago, first in a space across the street, but soon finding a home at 94-98 Nassau Avenue.
Customers can find magazines, puzzles, greeting cards, and even a Western Union. Most of the staff speaks Polish, not a requirement, but a show of the store’s dedication to keeping the area’s cultural heritage alive.
